text: 在旅途首页拾起长椅边的白贝，选一条小径让精灵出发。出发日之后，手表同步或手动记下一个好习惯，回来看看精灵找到什么。潮池的风铃能拨响，灯铺的灯可以换色，老邮局能印出你自己的明信片。点「请朋友来坐坐」，对方用浏览器就能看到你布置的海湾。

Pick up the white shell by the bench in Shenzhen Bay and choose an outing for your companion. On a later day, sync a habit from Apple Health or record one yourself to bring a find home. Ring your shell chime, change the lantern's color, or print a postcard at the mailbox. Invite a friend to see your bench in their browser.
